إجراء:
Equipment Inspection 
 (I1- Y1)

تاريخ الموافقة: 
 07 Sep 2006

تاريخ المراجعة: Sep 
 2011
مقدمة

This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be carried out on an annual bases as 
 indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The heating system is divided to two main subsystems: 
 Low Pressure heaters,
 High Pressure heaters.

LP heaters 
 subsystem uses for heating main condensate water, the main condensate water 
 flows from discharge main condensate water pumps to feed water tank via four 
 LP heaters. The heat transfer between the steam extraction & main condensate 
 water products condensate inside the LP heaters. The level controllers systems 
 keeps the condensate water level inside each LP heater. RTD and T/C for 
 measuring the inlet and outlet temperature of main condensate water for each 
 LP heater, the high level switches LP heaters protects the main condensate 
 water pumps.

HP heaters 
 subsystem uses for heating feed water, the feed water flows from feed water 
 tank to main feed water control valve via two HP heaters. The heat transfer 
 between the steam extraction between feed water products condensate inside the 
 HP heaters. the level controllers systems keeps the condensate water level 
 inside each hp heater, t/c for measuring the inlet and outlet temperature of 
 main condensate water for each HP heater, the high level switches HP heaters 
 protects the main feed water pumps and operate HP heaters bypass solenoid 
 valve .

Each LP heaters 
 subsystem consists of displacer level transmitter, pneumatic drain valve 
 (condensate water flows from heater to another heater), pneumatic emergency 
 valve (condensate water flows from heater to main condenser), pneumatic 
 positioner, electro-pneumatic positioner, electro-pneumatic converter, 
 solenoid valves, level switches and limit switches.

كل سخانات HP 
 يتكون النظام الفرعي من جهاز إرسال مستوى الإزاحة وصمام تصريف هوائي 
 (يتدفق الماء المتكثف من السخان إلى سخان آخر)، الطوارئ الهوائية 
 صمام (يتدفق الماء المتكثف من السخان إلى المكثف الرئيسي)، هوائي 
 جهاز تحديد المواقع ، جهاز تحديد المواقع الكهربائي الهوائي ، محول كهربائي هوائي ، 
 صمامات الملف اللولبي ومفاتيح الحد.

The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Mahmoud Saad Eldin Bakry, tested by eng Eslam Shoukry, revised by quality control eng. Abdel-Moniem 
 Al-Emam EDEPC, accepted by I&C general manager eng. Ibrahim El-Sayed, and 
 approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latef Mady: Head Sector of Ataka PS.
